description:
A modern spec and spacious three-bedroom flat located on Turnpike Lane in Hornsey. 96 Sqm / 1038 Sft in Size. 

The property has been tastefully decorated throughout and offers three well-sized bedrooms, along with a large open plan kitchen and reception room. The kitchen is fully fitted with an electric hob, oven, fridge freezer and washing machine.

Additional features include, gas central heating, double glazed windows, ample storage and high standard furniture is provided.

The flat is set in a lively and well-connected area moments from Turnpike Lane Underground Station (Piccadilly Line), as well as Hornsey Overground Station for quick access into the City. 

Local bus routes are excellent, and the high street offers a wide variety of shops, cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities. 

Ducketts Common and Priory Park are nearby, providing great open green spaces.

Available 08th of October, Contact Ariston Property to arrange a viewing.
